hky-meeting-notes v0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Provides automatic, structured meeting summary generation for eldercare and legacy planning scenarios.
- Organizes scattered inputs (voice transcripts, chat logs, notes) into a standardized matrix covering five key info areas.
- Highlights "information gaps" with explicit placeholders; does not invent data.
- Outputs include family structure sketches, risk signals, client profile, actionable follow-ups, and ready-to-send messages.
- Internal and external information clearly separated; privacy and compliance considerations emphasized.
